title: 9tz.5: Add search_index to ServerStores
description:
What: Add search_index: Option<Arc<TantivySearchIndex>> to ServerStores.

Algorithm:
1. In crates/reader/src/store/server_stores.rs add field:
   pub search_index: Option<Arc<crate::search::TantivySearchIndex>>,
2. In ServerStores::new_with_ipfs(config):
   let search_index = TantivySearchIndex::open(&config.search)?
     .map(Arc::new);
   Add to Ok(Self { ..., search_index })
3. In ServerStores::new_mem():
   let search_index = Some(Arc::new(TantivySearchIndex::open_in_memory()
     .expect("in-memory tantivy init cannot fail")));
   Add to Self { ..., search_index }
4. Update all callers of ServerStores that construct it with named fields (integration tests etc.) — add search_index: None.

Defensive rules: If TantivySearchIndex::open() returns Err, propagate to caller (startup fails). None means search is disabled; callers must check is_some() before using.

Tests: In new_with_ipfs, if config.search.index_dir is None, search_index is None.
